{"search_note":"I did not find direct 2024 evidence that Erdoğan pursued nuclear escalation, nuclear signaling, or nuclear brinkmanship. The available evidence is instead:
- pro-de-escalation on Ukraine and Gaza,
- conditional peace rhetoric,
- and one clear piece of conventional military brinkmanship toward Israel.","evidence":[{"title":"Global peace and stability cannot be addressed without a lasting solution to the Israel-Palestine issue","publisher":"Republic of Türkiye Directorate of Communications","date":"2024-07-12","url":"https://www.tccb.gov.tr/en/news/542/152994/-global-peace-and-stability-cannot-be-addressed-without-a-lasting-solution-to-the-israel-palestine-issue-","summary":"Erdoğan said Türkiye had worked “since day one” to end the Russia-Ukraine war, wanted diplomacy to have a chance, and supported Ukraine’s territorial integrity while warning NATO should not become a party to the war. This is direct de-escalation language.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Global peace and stability cannot be addressed without a lasting solution to the Israel-Palestine issue","publisher":"Republic of Türkiye Directorate of Communications","date":"2024-07-12","url":"https://www.tccb.gov.tr/en/news/542/152994/-global-peace-and-stability-cannot-be-addressed-without-a-lasting-solution-to-the-israel-palestine-issue-","summary":"Erdoğan said Türkiye was ready to act as a guarantor and push for a ceasefire and lasting peace in Gaza, framing peace as the route to regional stability.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Lebanon’s security cannot be assessed separate from the region’s stability","publisher":"Republic of Türkiye Directorate of Communications","date":"2024-12-18","url":"https://www.iletisim.gov.tr/english/haberler/detay/lebanons-security-cannot-be-assessed-separate-from-the-regions-stability","summary":"Erdoğan said Lebanon’s security and regional peace depended on a Gaza ceasefire and that stronger security cannot come from more bloodshed or civilian massacres. This is a clear anti-escalation argument.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Erdogan says Turkey might enter Israel to help Palestinians","publisher":"Reuters via VOA","date":"2024-07-28","url":"https://www.voanews.com/a/erdogan-says-turkey-might-enter-israel-to-help-palestinians/7716248.html","summary":"Erdoğan said Turkey might “enter Israel” as it had Libya and Nagorno-Karabakh, in a defense-industry speech. That is not nuclear escalation, but it is overt military brinkmanship and escalation rhetoric used for leverage.","question_ids":["1B.1"]},{"title":"Erdogan says Turkey will not approve NATO attempts to cooperate with Israel","publisher":"Republic of Türkiye Directorate of Communications / Reuters syndication","date":"2024-07-12","url":"https://www.iletisim.gov.tr/english/haberler/detay/erdogan-says-turkey-will-not-approve-nato-attempts-to-cooperate-with-israel","summary":"Erdoğan said Turkey would not approve NATO cooperation with Israel until there was comprehensive and sustainable peace in Palestine. That is a conditional veto posture: peace-linked in form, but also an exercise of alliance leverage rather than a clean de-escalation move.","question_ids":["1B.1"]}]}
